question: In which of the following cities is the Jawaharlal Nehru Manipur Dance Academy located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Imphal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jawaharlal Nehru Manipur Dance Academy** is located in the capital city of **Manipur, Imphal**.
 
• It is a unit of** New Delhi-based Sangeet Natak Academy**, dedicated to teaching **Manipuri dance and music**.
 
• It was **established in 1954**, and its **management comes under the Sangeet Natak Academy**.
 
• It is a premier Institute for** promoting and preserving Manipuri culture and heritage**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• It offers 3 years of diploma and foundation courses in different disciplines, especially in **Dance and Sankirtan, which aims at providing professional training in Manipuri dance and music.**
 
• It comes under the** Ministry of Culture of the Indian Government**.
